name: council
description: LLM Council - get answers from multiple model configurations, have them evaluate each other anonymously, and synthesize the best response

interface.shortDescription: Run baseline and dynamic LLM council workflows.
interface.longDescription: Council bundles two skill variants for multi-model deliberation: a fast baseline council and an adaptive dynamic council that scales depth with complexity and stakes.
defaultPrompt: Convene the baseline council for this question.
Use the dynamic council for a high-stakes decision.
Compare the baseline and dynamic council approaches for this prompt.
